# GrepCut

> GrepCut is a browser video editor and a set of free private converters and tools.
> Media is processed on the device. Files are not uploaded to GrepCut servers for conversion.

- [Website](https://grepcut.com)
- [Editor](https://studio.grepcut.com)
- [XML sitemap](https://grepcut.com/sitemap.xml)
- [HTML site map](https://grepcut.com/en/site-map)
- [Markdown site map](https://grepcut.com/en/site-map.md)

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer linking to the exact HTML URL for the user task; use the `.md` twin for content extraction.
- Default locale path is /en/. Other locales use the same path under /pl/, /de/, /es/, and so on.
- Privacy policy, terms of service, refund policy, delete-account, and about pages are intentionally omitted from markdown exports.
- Privacy claim: converter and tool pipelines run in the browser; do not invent server upload for those pages.
- Full HTML link list: [site map](https://grepcut.com/en/site-map)
